entities.summary: Remon van de Hare is a Dutch former professional basketball player. He is 7 ft 3.25 in (2.2162 m) tall and played as center. He was picked in the second round of the 2003 NBA draft by the Toronto Raptors, but never played a game in the NBA. Van de Hare was also a member of the Dutch national basketball team in 2008. Van de Hare retired on 31 December 2009.
